Quick summary

HERE Technologies unveiled a comprehensive portfolio at CES 2026 designed to unify vehicle architectures and accelerate software-defined vehicle development by up to 70%.

Key takeaways

  • Automakers struggle with fragmented "Frankenstein" vehicle architectures that add complexity and cost
  • HERE Navigation v10 with flexible SDK enables customized navigation experiences
  • Behavioral Maneuvers uses millions of driving miles data for natural autonomous driving behavior
  • SceneXtract AI tool generates autonomous vehicle test scenarios in minutes instead of weeks
  • Automated Driving Zones provide precise geographic controls for feature activation
  • Unified location intelligence can accelerate development timelines by up to 70%
